definitions.percentile: nearest rank: the element at ceil(q*n)-1 of the ascending sample, no interpolation
definitions.low1Percent: the MEAN of the slowest ceil(n/100) frames -- not p99, which is a single frame
definitions.low01Percent: the mean of the slowest ceil(n/1000) frames; with ~108 measured frames this is one frame and equals max
definitions.deltaMs: baseline minus arm: positive means the arm was faster
definitions.cpuFrameMs: SceneRenderer::render() plus, on the offline path, Finish/Submit and the block on the queue -- so it includes waiting for the GPU; see cpuStageMedianMs.queueWait before calling a frame CPU-bound
definitions.comparability: records may only be compared when their conditions.sessionId is the same
